about.description: Arcus perpetual market tracking Alibaba Group Holding Limited (ADR) (NYSE: BABA) with 24/7 exposure to the underlying Chinese e-commerce ADR. Total-return tracking (dividends, splits, and futures rolls passed through funding), cash-settled in USDG on the Arcus off-chain CLOB with permissioned appchain re-verification and EVM rootchain custody.
